description: SINOE ® - Destination des DMA collectés par type de traitement is published by ADEME. The table assigns collected waste tonnage to treatment destinations and waste groups. Its stated coverage is France; department-level odd-numbered survey years from 2009. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. Reported destination categories are not a full geocoded transport network. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
